production.order: Generate s01 first (the hardest: two people from one reference, swimming with both faces visible) and inspect it at 900/360/250/180 px and in the centered 4:5 crop before sending the rest; then s02, s03 and s04. A rejected output is reported with its cost; a redo needs a changed prompt in a new revision.

shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture, soft natural morning light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere: clothing, signs and equipment are plain. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep every person, whole, inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.pool: The setting is an outdoor swimming pool with clear blue water on a bright, calm morning; a few green trees and a plain pale wall are softly out of focus behind the far edge. The camera is low, just above the water a few steps in front of the swimmer, so the head, shoulders and reaching arms are large and sharp in the middle of the frame. Swimming is the most obvious thing in the photo: the body is stretched out flat in the water behind the head, the arms reach forward in a breaststroke with a little splash, and the feet do not touch the bottom. No swimming cap, no goggles; the face is fully visible.
shared_prompts.park: The setting is a wide paved path through a green park on a bright, calm morning, with grass and trees softly out of focus behind. The camera is at chest height a few steps in front, and the runner is seen whole from head to running shoes. Running is the most obvious thing in the photo: a real jogging stride toward the camera, one foot clearly off the ground, elbows bent, a relaxed smile, the face fully visible.
